summary: The candidate clears the stale candidate checkpoint when a closed unmerged publication branch was deleted, enabling prepareImplementationStart to refresh the issue base before the fresh attempt. Regression coverage seeds a stale checkpoint for both the serial recovery and matrix planner paths and asserts the refreshed current base while preserving counters and retry charging.

evidence: src/repair/loop-existing-head-continuation.ts adds checkpoint: null to the deleted-branch reset alongside head and pr null.
prepareImplementationStart refreshes target.base only when head, checkpoint, pr and intent are null, so the cleared checkpoint enables the current-base restart.
tests/repair/loop-closed-existing-head_test.ts adds a stale-checkpoint planner case asserting the request base is the current SHA3 and the checkpoint is null.
The modified deleted-branch serial test now seeds a checkpoint and asserts it is cleared after recovery.
